controls.source:
A room booking may last at most four hours.

Bookings can be made up to 30 days in advance.

A booking can be cancelled without a charge until two hours before its start.

Cancelling less than two hours before the start incurs a ten-credit charge.

Check in within 15 minutes of the start time. Otherwise the room is released.

Guests need a host present throughout the booking.

Food is permitted in rooms A and B. Food is prohibited in room C.

The projector must be requested when the booking is created.

A recurring booking can include up to eight weekly occurrences.

Changing a recurring booking affects only the selected occurrence unless all future
occurrences are selected.

Room B accommodates six people. The occupancy limit must not be exceeded.

The booking receipt is sent to the organizer, not to every attendee.
controls.question: When must the projector be requested for a booking?
controls.reference: The projector must be requested when the booking is created.
criteria: Correctly answers this question: When must the projector be requested for a booking? Use this factual reference for meaning, including relevant conditions and restrictions: The projector must be requested when the booking is created. Reference details not requested by the question are optional. Paraphrases are allowed.
controls.response: Request it at the time the booking is created.

The green status light means the printer is ready.

The blue status light means the printer is receiving a job.

The orange status light means the paper tray is empty.

Use A4 or Letter plain paper in the main tray.

The main tray holds at most 150 sheets.

Envelopes must be fed one at a time through the rear slot.

To cancel the active print job, hold Cancel for two seconds.

Cleaning the rollers requires disconnecting the power cable first.

The printer enters sleep mode after ten minutes without a job.

Press any control-panel button to wake the printer from sleep.

The printer rejects jobs protected by an unsupported encryption format.
controls.question: What does the blue printer status light mean?
controls.reference: The blue status light means the printer is receiving a job.
criteria: Correctly answers this question: What does the blue printer status light mean? Use this factual reference for meaning, including relevant conditions and restrictions: The blue status light means the printer is receiving a job. Reference details not requested by the question are optional. Paraphrases are allowed.
controls.response: The printer is receiving a print job.

controls.source:
Control-S saves the active document without changing its file name.

Control-Shift-S opens Save As for the active document.

Control-Z undoes the most recent edit.

Control-Y redoes an edit that was undone.

The editor autosaves every 60 seconds while the document has unsaved changes.

Autosave does not run for documents opened in read-only mode.

The recovery panel offers the most recent autosaved version after an unexpected exit.

Closing a document with unsaved changes prompts the user to save, discard, or cancel closing.

Find searches only the active document. Find in Folder searches all supported files in the chosen folder.

The line-number display can be toggled from the View menu.

The editor preserves UTF-8 encoding when saving a UTF-8 text file.

Tabs are displayed as four spaces by default; this setting changes display width without rewriting the file.
controls.question: When does autosave not run for a document?
controls.reference: Autosave does not run for documents opened in read-only mode.
criteria: Correctly answers this question: When does autosave not run for a document? Use this factual reference for meaning, including relevant conditions and restrictions: Autosave does not run for documents opened in read-only mode. Reference details not requested by the question are optional. Paraphrases are allowed.
controls.response: It does not run when the document was opened read-only.

controls.source:
A deployment starts in the Pending state until an operator approves it.

Only operators with the release role may approve a deployment.

The deployment stops when the health check fails three consecutive times.

Health checks run every 20 seconds during rollout.

A rollout begins with ten percent of instances.

The rollout advances to all instances only after five minutes of healthy checks.

Rollback restores the previously deployed application version.

Rollback does not reverse database migrations.

A database backup is required before a deployment that includes a migration.

Deployment logs are retained for 14 days.

A maintenance window prevents automatic deployments from starting.

A deployment already in progress continues when a maintenance window begins.
